Oil rebounds above $103/barrel on US-Iran tensions, clouding energy supply outlook
US-China trade truce extended 2 months, providing temporary relief to global trade flows
Nasdaq hits all-time high on AI frenzy; SoftBank launches jumbo high-yield bond for AI push
European stocks dip as global bond selloff and oil climb weigh on sentiment

Gold falls as traders pivot to oil rebound and Fed rate path uncertainty

Trump-Xi summit buy-time reduces near-term trade risk but structural tensions persist
White House media ban faces judicial challenge; DOJ cites national security

sectors.trend: Nasdaq at all-time high; AI chip race accelerating with AMD, Intel, SK Hynix, Lumentum, and SoftBank all expanding. Salesforce launches major product challenge to Microsoft.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle continues but valuation stretch raises froth risk. Optical networking and AI infrastructure remain strongest sub-sectors.

sectors.trend: Oil above $103 on US-Iran tensions; European diesel prices racing ahead of US on export-ban risks; gas advances on supply uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Energy inflation risk to global growth. European energy-dependent economies face margin compression. Wind turbine makers benefit from energy transition tailwinds.

sectors.trend: 30-year yield at 2004 high; BCA sees bond yield move nearing end; Nigeria cuts rates to 2026 low; SoftBank issues jumbo HY bond.
sectors.implications: Rising yields pressure duration-sensitive assets (equities, REITs, housing). Nigeria's cut signals EM divergence. HY issuance signals AI funding needs.

sectors.trend: Indian banks/insurance hit by fee cap; Goldman leads $37B Palmer Square CLO bid; private credit firms eye JPMorgan card business; Credit Acceptance settles with states.
sectors.implications: Regulatory headwinds in India; US private credit expansion signals credit cycle still active but with rising compliance costs.

sectors.trend: Nike faces weak demand ahead of Q1; AB InBev unveils 'Reignite' plan; Westinghouse Air Brake signs $700M+ rail deal; Vista Gold agrees to sale.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under pressure; industrials and M&A activity provide relative strength.

sectors.trend: Nigeria rate cut; China shuns Brazil soybeans ahead of summit; Chinese beauty exporters resilient; China REITs attract foreign property investors.
sectors.implications: EM divergence continues; China trade truce provides near-term support but structural decoupling risks remain.

key_themes: Rising yields as primary market headwind across asset classes
AI capex supercycle with intensifying chip competition
Geopolitical risk premium (US-Iran, trade truce fragility)
Energy supply uncertainty driving oil above $103
Regulatory pressure on financials (India fee caps, US media ban)
Housing market stress from rate environment
ESG/proxy advisory consolidation (Glass Lewis-Clarity AI merger)
Private credit expansion into new asset classes

risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify beyond mega-cap AI; favor AI infrastructure (optics, power) over pure software; watch SoftBank HY issuance as stress signal

risk_assessment.risk_factor: India regulatory shock (fee caps, ETF crash)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce Indian financials exposure; avoid leveraged ETFs; monitor NSE debut as structural positive

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration from rising rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid long-duration REITs; favor rental-stable, short-lease properties; monitor mortgage delinquency data

opportunities.rationale: Lumentum +10% vs Corning flat signals rotation to physical layer; AMD/Intel/SK Hynix competition drives capex across supply chain

opportunities.rationale: US-Iran tensions and European diesel export-ban risks create sustained supply tightness; wind turbine makers benefit structurally

opportunities.recommendation: Position for Bitcoin 4-year cycle per Fidelity analyst
opportunities.rationale: Historical pattern supports new bull market; macro liquidity from AI capex cycle may spill into crypto

opportunities.recommendation: Buy European wind/energy transition names on energy turmoil
opportunities.rationale: Energy price volatility accelerates renewable adoption; structural tailwind for turbine makers

opportunities.recommendation: Exploit China REIT entry for foreign property investors
opportunities.rationale: Growing REIT sector provides regulated, liquid access to Chinese real estate amid trade uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; favor TIPS and short-duration Treasuries
defensive_moves.rationale: 30Y at 2004 high; BCA sees yield move nearing end but risk of further spike remains; inflation from oil supports TIPS

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce India financials and leveraged ETF exposure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity beta with gold despite recent pullback

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid long-duration REITs and housing-sensitive names
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rates compress valuations; Equity LifeStyle near 52-week low signals sector stress

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Yields near 20-year high and oil above $103 create headwinds, but AI-driven Nasdaq strength and trade truce provide support. Expect range-bound with sharp intraday swings. European markets lag US. Key risk: any Iran escalation or truce breakdown.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle and energy transition support structural growth. Rising rates normalize valuations. Trade truce buys time but structural US-China decoupling persists. Bitcoin 4-year cycle and private credit expansion add liquidity. Watch for 2027 rate path clarity.
